unit: Continuous-density lower bounds, upper-test linearization and bounded mixed Monge-Ampere inequalities
files_read: The complete new Q08 input directly read twice at statement-to-proof scale around the first build and visual inspection. Both adjoining Q08 transitions and the changed history paragraph directly read; final history spacing reread. These are scoped unit reads, not fresh whole-Q08 reads.

Earlier canonical psh representatives, determinant normalization, bounded comparison and mixed decreasing continuity consulted at their exact scopes. The complete real harmonic comparison and distributional-subharmonic interfaces were consulted; earlier verified proof evidence retained.

SGPT envelope thm:Yau_rel/thm:AY_rel statements and their explicit delegation consulted. Published DDNL Theorems4.28/4.29 and complete uniqueness proof, pp.2079–2080, directly reread during this research; BEGZ Proposition1.11, printed211, complete proof directly reread. Their dependence on a general local mixed inequality remains open.
source_locators_checked: Exact EGZ arXiv1007.0076v1: local setup p.4; complete Proposition1.3 supporting proof and Lemma1.4 p.5; complete Proposition1.5 proof pp.6–7, including Lemmas1.6/1.7. Original pp.5–7 images inspected. Other statements on p.7 consulted only as context.

Exact Dinew arXiv0705.0974v1: full pp.1–10 directly read during local mixed/uniqueness research; pp.1–2 reread and original images inspected. Theorem1.2 quotes its L1 extension rather than proving it; general-measure proof depends on external Dirichlet/energy/stability results, which are not imported. Last two pages only partially consulted.
proof_scope: Positive-semidefinite matrix determinant infimum, mixed two-matrix inequality by subset-product AMGM, constant elliptic upper tests imply distributional lower bounds by harmonic comparison and explicit fundamental-solution convolution, bounded Monge-Ampere continuous-density three-way equivalence, and mixed decreasing-convolution passage. Dimensions n>=1, zero densities, singular matrices, finite comparison measures and endpoint powers are explicit. No Hormander viscosity theorem, general L1-density extension, local Dirichlet theorem or common-measure inequality is imported.
review_method: Two scoped direct mathematical/editorial reads by the authoring agent, not independent certification. Eighteen first selected manuscript images inspected. All433 pages rendered and compared after history fit; all15 changed images inspected. Unchanged selected images carry the earlier direct visual review.
